name: split-stance-pallof-press
instructions:
1. Attach a handle to a cable stack at chest height and assume a split stance with the feet slightly wider than hip width.
2. Hold the handle to your chest and assume an athletic base position with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart in a split stance.
3. Press the handle horizontally to extension as you exhale.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
